features: Hybrid operation with up to 24 analogue channels as an optional upgrade
Flash module for the operating system
2x RS232 serial ports; RS485 full duplex optional
SATA output for DAS-4 Eco storage extension (optional)
notes: SMAVIA-era DMS 2400; a separate product from the DMS 2400 II and the DMS 2400 MK4.
Power consumption is max. 145 W without encoder boards and max. 170 W with 3 encoder boards (24 analogue channels).
The connection diagram shows 16 BNC video inputs (Video IN 1-16) and 16 analogue audio inputs; the feature list gives up to 24 analogue channels with the hybrid upgrade.
Contact inputs: 24 camera contacts plus 6 global contacts. Audio inputs: 16 for analogue cameras (D-SUB), 1 microphone, 1 AUX/line.
Dimensions are stated in inches only: approx. 16.7 x 4.8 x 17.6 in without feet, 16.7 x 5.1 x 17.6 in with feet.
